text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno didn't seem to be feeling well, 
so I decided to let her rest in the 
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I apologize, but I will be taking a brief 
nap...

text_block_list.name: Gol-san
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa~~ For the ruthless 
Detective Meno to fall asleep during an 
investigation, is it gonna snow or 
something?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
A-An investigation? Detectives? What on 
earth are you talking about, sir?!

text_block_list.name: Gol-san
text_block_list.text:
Nothing to say about it. It's an order 
from up top, ain't it?

text_block_list.name: Dori-san
text_block_list.text:
Another detachment is pursuing the carrot 
thief. ...Gol-san and Meno-san, please 
standby at your designated positions just 
in case...

text_block_list.name: King Detective
text_block_list.text:
...It's Dori-san's order. Don't mess up, 
got it?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
N-Now that you mention it, I'm starting to 
feel that way too, sir...
(Ringgg, ringgg)

text_block_list.name: Gol-san
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Sousouken here... Oh, it's you, 
Sukajan. Today's special is sushi curry.

text_block_list.name: Sukajan Detective
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... Is this really the time to 
fool around? I've driven that robber your 
way.

text_block_list.name: Sukajan Detective
text_block_list.text:
"Can't say it's a good hand, but... 
Interesting. I'll bet on you bastards!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I see! Dori-san had us on standby here 
from the beginning just for this!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
This responsibility entrusted to me by 
everyone's belief... I must fulfill it, 
without fail—!!

text_block_list.name: Robber
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*... Finally shook them off. 
Heh heh, guess I'll celebrate with a drink 
from what I swiped—

text_block_list.name: Gol-san
text_block_list.text: Just surrender quietly—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: WE'VE ARRIIIIVEEED!!!

text_block_list.name: Gol-san
text_block_list.text:
Heh, nothin' beats a cold drink after 
crackin' a case.

text_block_list.name: Dori-san
text_block_list.text:
Good work, you two... The Boss would like 
to personally express his gratitude to 
both of you.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Huh, from the Boss? U-Um... Phenomeno 
reporting, sir—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? The infirmary...?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. So that was all a dream, was 
it...?"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Although it is unfortunate that I couldn't 
speak with the Boss...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: However, it was a delightful dream!!

Thanks to that passionate dream, 
Fenomeno's condition had completely 
recovered.
